chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The best of worship is the saying: There is no god except Allah.'

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god except Allah (Tahleel)

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best form of worship in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the verbal affirmation of Tawhid as the apex of worship, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of knowledge and action where declaration precedes and informs deeper spiritual states. It underscores the theological principle that recognizing divine oneness is not merely a creed but the most potent form of devotion, linking the heart's conviction with the tongue's testimony.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The best of the (acts of) worship are the words,
‘There is no god except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘The best form of worship is saying, ‘No one deserves to be worshipped except Allah.’”
